headline: Product-grid and product-page visual polish
summary: Small visual refinements to the catalog grid and product page. Product tiles previously all carried the same fixed corner glow, so a grid of them read as one card stamped repeatedly; the glow position now rotates per tile so the grid looks like a designed set. The product page's buy box gets clearer elevation so it reads as a distinct purchase surface, and the fallback placeholder shown for a product with no image is now legible on the dark theme instead of a near-invisible mark.

items.title: Product tiles no longer share one identical glow
items.body: Each product card's media glow now rotates through a set of positions per tile (matching the collection cards) instead of every tile glowing in the exact same corner, so a full grid reads as a designed set rather than a single card repeated.

items.title: Clearer product-page buy box
items.body: The product page's buy box gains a stronger border and a soft shadow so it stands out from the page as the purchase surface.

items.title: Legible image-less placeholder
items.body: The fallback artwork shown when a product has no image was nearly invisible on the dark canvas; its contrast is lifted (grid lines, shield detail, and caption) so it reads as an intentional placeholder. Applied identically on the edge and container render paths.
